SRC-007:R0001.text: Keep OUTAUDIT, CAPTURE, INAUDIT layers, and GG/CC execution as separate concepts and state machines.

SRC-007:R0002.text: Provide a transparent filesystem-backed global INAUDIT Inbox with canonical UUID body and metadata pairs and complete provenance fields.

SRC-007:R0003.text: A successful capture ACK means the normalized body and metadata are durably and atomically saved; partial pairs are retained as RECOVERY diagnostics.

SRC-007:R0004.text: Expose authenticated loopback capture list/detail/create/assign/archive/delete/restore endpoints with idempotent capture identity and bounded validation.

SRC-007:R0005.text: Add one-click IA actions for stable whole assistant responses and individual blocks while preserving source text and showing ready/sending/saved/queued/error states.

SRC-007:R0006.text: Persist offline browser captures in bounded IndexedDB using the same capture_id, durable transaction completion, capped backoff, and delete only after durable Bridge ACK.

SRC-007:R0007.text: Classify captures deterministically from registered project paths, names, unique files and symbols, aliases, weak hints, and explicit-assignment conversation affinity.

SRC-007:R0008.text: Classification is explainable evidence with STRONG/SUGGESTED/UNASSIGNED thresholds and never auto-writes a project layer.

SRC-007:R0009.text: Generate compact local titles and retain source URL, browser, timestamp, and conversation fingerprint without secrets, cookies, or unrelated conversation data.

SRC-007:R0010.text: Extend Qt INAUDIT into compact Layers and Inbox views with list, detail, confidence evidence, destination preview, actions, counters, and debounced filesystem generation watching.

SRC-007:R0011.text: Assignment must accept only a registered project, rescan canonical numeric layers, allocate max plus one, never overwrite, atomically publish, verify SHA-256, then update metadata.

SRC-007:R0012.text: Assign plus GG or CC may copy or invoke only the exact verified canonical assigned path and must not run when assignment fails.

SRC-007:R0013.text: Provide desktop IA+ clipboard capture through the same capture store with only a weak selected-project hint.

SRC-007:R0014.text: Support duplicate-body marking, explicit archive and delete, recoverable history, status model, source opening, and exact text copy.

SRC-007:R0015.text: Show compact per-project local layer plus suggested Inbox counts and a global pending plus unassigned Inbox count without disk scanning during paint.

SRC-007:R0016.text: Reset, restart, GUI close, widget restart, and audit cancel must not erase or couple durable Inbox or offline capture state.

SRC-007:R0017.text: Browser capture must be read-only toward ChatGPT and independent of clean-chat eligibility, composer state, Browser Dispatcher leases, dispatch IDs, and campaign run IDs.

SRC-007:R0018.text: Mandatory capture, classifier, assignment, API, Qt, and Widget IA unit and integration tests pass, including races, recovery, exact text, idempotence, occupied chat, and bounded retry.
